In the community discussion, Arthas Menethil suggests adding a small seating area to the children's play area, describing it as "a nice spot to enjoy the flowers and herbs would be amazing. Maybe some benches or chairs around?" However, there is no mention of adding outdoor games or a water feature specifically to the children's play area in this particular discussion.

Regarding the addition of a water feature, Arthas Menethil also expresses interest in incorporating one, stating, "I think a small pond or a fountain would work well! They’re not too complicated and can really enhance the overall feel of the garden." He goes on to suggest adding rocks around the fountain to enhance its natural appearance and blending it into the garden. 

Therefore, it appears that while the initial suggestion was for a seating area, the broader suggestion of a water feature was brought up by Arthas Menethil during the community discussions. However, the specific proposal for outdoor games was not mentioned in the provided data.
